summary: Procure GitHub Enterprise Cloud (Advanced Auditing) + External Collaborator Seat Pool
description:
Issue summary:
We need to purchase GitHub Enterprise Cloud for the Redwood org with the Advanced Auditing add-on and a pool of seats for external collaborators and contractors. This request covers: annual billing, SCIM/SCIM provisioning via Okta, SCIM user sync configuration, org-level retention settings, and admin seat reassignment workflows.

Business impact:
- Legal/compliance requires advanced audit logs for Q3 SOC2 scope expansion.
- Engineering contractor ramp ups starting 2026-04 require ~40 external seats available immediately.
- Current GitHub plan is a legacy team plan that cannot enable the required audit features.

Requested by / Owner: Priya Kapoor (Platform Engineering)
Cost center / Budget owner: ENG-Platform (charge to ENG ops budget)
Quantity and term: 120 total seats (80 core employees + 40 external collaborator pool), 12-month annual term starting April 1 2026.
Vendor contact and quote ref: GitHub sales (sales rep: Maria Del Rio), quote ID GH-0426-RWI-001, quoted annual list: $82,800 (before discount).

Required deliverables:
- PO and signed MSA addendum for Advanced Auditing.
- SCIM automation runbook and Okta integration completed by SSO team.
- Finance invoice schedule and billing account created.
- Admin training for audit console and retention configuration.

Environment: N/A (org-level SaaS)

Steps to provision/proposed rollout plan:
1) Legal review MSA addendum and DPA (target 5 business days).
2) Finance approves and issues PO (target 3 business days after legal).
3) GitHub sales finalizes contract and returns countersigned doc (target 3 business days).
4) SSO/Identity completes SCIM mapping and test sync in staging (target 7 business days).
5) Production cutover and seat assignments (target 1 business day).
6) Post-provision audit and a two-week validation window.

Attachments/links: quote GH-0426-RWI-001 (link to Google Drive), sample contract in Confluence: /confluence/platform/vendor-contracts/github-enterprise, Slack thread: #it-procurement (thread ts: 1678453012.000200)
investigation_notes:
Initial research: Advanced Auditing is a paid add-on for Enterprise Cloud. Confirmed current org is on a legacy plan that can't be upgraded without a contract amendment. Finance flagged that the quote includes an auto-renew clause; legal wants to remove auto-renew or add 60-day cancel notice.

Technical notes: SCIM provisioning tested with a demo Okta tenant — mapping for user.email, user.displayName, and groups works but GitHub SCIM rate limits may require batching for large syncs. Feature flags for audit log retention default to 90 days; compliance requested 365-day retention, which will need additional retention cost — vendor says retention extension is part of Advanced Auditing addon.

Discount negotiation: Sales indicated potential 10-18% discount if we commit to 24-month term; finance prefers 12 months. Recommended to negotiate a 12-month with 12% discount and no auto-renew.

Risk assessment: Migration risk is low but org-level permission changes need careful coordination. External collaborator seat pool will be implemented using Billing Seat pooling feature; ensure contractors are provisioned as outside collaborators when possible to avoid license churn.
